tools.name: teamwork_me
tools.description: Return the Teamwork person behind the API key (name, email, company, id). Use it to learn your own user id. Teamwork API: GET /projects/api/v3/me.json.

tools.name: teamwork_list_projects
tools.description: List projects visible to the API key, with status, dates and company. Filter by search text. Teamwork API: GET /projects/api/v3/projects.json.

tools.name: teamwork_get_project
tools.description: Get one project by id: name, status, start and end dates, description and company. Teamwork API: GET /projects/api/v3/projects/{id}.json.

tools.name: teamwork_list_tasklists
tools.description: List task lists (the groups tasks sit in). Give project_id to list one project's lists, or leave it out for all visible lists. Teamwork API: GET /projects/api/v3/projects/{id}/tasklists.json or /projects/api/v3/tasklists.json.

tools.name: teamwork_list_tasks
tools.description: List tasks, with assignees, due dates and status. Give tasklist_id or project_id to narrow the list; tasklist_id wins when both are given. Teamwork API: GET /projects/api/v3/tasklists/{id}/tasks.json, /projects/api/v3/projects/{id}/tasks.json or /projects/api/v3/tasks.json.

tools.name: teamwork_get_task
tools.description: Get one task by id: name, description, status, assignees, tasklist, start and due dates. Teamwork API: GET /projects/api/v3/tasks/{id}.json.

tools.name: teamwork_list_people
tools.description: List people (users) visible to the API key. Give project_id to list one project's members. Teamwork API: GET /projects/api/v3/people.json or /projects/api/v3/projects/{id}/people.json.

tools.name: teamwork_list_timelogs
tools.description: List time entries (timelogs) with minutes, billable flag, user and date. Give task_id or project_id to narrow the list; task_id wins when both are given. Dates are inclusive. Teamwork API: GET /projects/api/v3/tasks/{id}/time.json, /projects/api/v3/projects/{id}/time.json or /projects/api/v3/time.js

tools.name: teamwork_create_task
tools.description: Create a task in a task list. Give a name and optionally a description and start and due dates. Teamwork API: POST /projects/api/v3/tasklists/{id}/tasks.json.

tools.name: teamwork_update_task
tools.description: Change a task's name, description, start or due date, or move it to another task list. Only the fields you pass change. Teamwork API: PUT /projects/api/v3/tasks/{id}.json.

tools.name: teamwork_complete_task
tools.description: Mark a task as complete. Reverse it with teamwork_uncomplete_task. Teamwork API: PUT /tasks/{id}/complete.json.

tools.name: teamwork_uncomplete_task
tools.description: Mark a completed task as open again. Teamwork API: PUT /tasks/{id}/uncomplete.json.

tools.name: teamwork_create_timelog
tools.description: Add a time entry to a task for a day. Give hours, minutes or both. Teamwork API: POST /projects/api/v3/tasks/{id}/time.json.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: teamwork_me, teamwork_create_task · Private data: teamwork_me, teamwork_list_projects, teamwork_list_people · Public sink: teamwork_me, teamwork_create_task, teamwork_create_timelog.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: teamwork_me, teamwork_create_task · Private data: teamwork_me, teamwork_list_projects, teamwork_list_people · Public sink: teamwork_me, teamwork_create_task, teamwork_create_timelog

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
